known_limitation: Seeded public-fixture hashes initially use reduced-cost Argon2id m=1024 KiB,t=1,p=1 and therefore do not meet the general OWASP minimum. This is explicitly authorized for fixture accounts only; signup hashes use m=47104 KiB,t=2, and successful seeded login upgrades to those full parameters. No plaintext is persisted or exported and no reset/export/import timeout waiver applies.

direct_final_ruling.quote: Seeded fixture passwords are public test input. They may use Argon2id at reduced cost (m=1024 KiB, t=1, p=1) with a unique salt per user, and are rehashed with the signup parameters after the user's first successful login. Signups keep the full parameters (m=47104 KiB, t=2). No plaintext is persisted or exported.
direct_final_ruling.salt_followup_result: PASS: identical seeded passwords have distinct salts before any login; initial export has no plaintext; wrong-password login does not rehash; successful login upgrades to full signup cost.
